EMPIRICAL INTRAVENOUS REGIMENS WITHOUT VANCOMYCIN
Gentamicin is optional.  Contact Hematology-Oncology or Infectious Diseases for
advice.

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h \($35/day\) R  < OR >](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h \($33/day\) R < OR >](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h \($33/day\) R <AND> gentamicin 5](orz-set-abx-pip-tazo-4-5-gm-iv-q6h-gent-5mg-iv-qd)

mg/kg IV q24h ($3/day) [R]

Therapy:
## Alternatives for penicillin allergy

Vancomycin must be added to aztreonam for coverage of Gram-positive organisms.

[Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h \($50/day\) <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-aztreon-2gm-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

($6/day) [R] < OR >
[Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h \($50/day\) <AND> gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h \($3/day\)](orz-set-abx-aztreon-2g-q8h-gent-5mg-kg-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

[R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($6.00/day) [R]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU EMP INTRAV W/O VANCO
